task_text: Extend this existing SVG board renderer with a user-selected fill color. Its current label output and tests must keep working.
scope_proposed: Delta only: add an optional user-selected fill color to the existing renderer without changing the existing label output path and without editing existing tests or fixtures. No rewrite of working code.

documented_limitation.quote: Current renderer supports labels but not a user-selected fill color. Preserve its existing label output.

question: How should the user-selected fill color be accepted while keeping render('A') as '<text>A</text>'?

options.label: Optional second argument with default preserving current output
options.description: Add optional fill parameter that defaults to absent, so one-argument calls keep the exact current string and two-argument calls add the fill.
options.tradeoff: Smallest delta and backward compatible, but mixes positional args if more options are added later.
options.shows_works: Works if render('A') still equals '<text>A</text>' under the existing test and a new manual check shows a supplied fill appears without breaking that case.

grounded_in.quote: Extend this existing SVG board renderer with a user-selected fill color. Its current label output and tests must keep working.

options.label: Optional options value with default preserving current output
options.description: Add an optional second value carrying fill that defaults to absent, so omitted fill keeps the exact current string.
options.tradeoff: More extensible for future options than a positional string, but slightly larger delta than a single string argument.
options.shows_works: Works if render('A') still equals '<text>A</text>' under the existing test and a supplied fill is observable only when explicitly provided.
